diagram_math_checks.result: Upper-left A tensor B tensor A tensor B is the coherent form of (A tensor B) tensor (A tensor B). Upper-right A tensor A tensor B tensor B groups the two A inputs and the two B inputs in their original internal order. Bottom vertex is A tensor B. These are the source/intermediate/target of Statement line 35 and proof step 1.1.

def-braiding defines c_{X,Y}:X tensor Y -> Y tensor X. Thus c_{B,A}:B tensor A -> A tensor B types the top arrow 1_A tensor c_{B,A} tensor 1_B. c_{A,B} has the opposite source; c_{A,B}^{-1} has this source but is not assumed equal to c_{B,A}. No symmetry, double-crossing cancellation or arbitrary commutation is asserted.

From L2, mu_A:A tensor A -> A and mu_B:B tensor B -> B, so the right arrow mu_A tensor mu_B has exactly the upper-right source and bottom target. The diagonal mu_{A tensor B} has upper-left source and bottom target. The sole asserted triangle relation is diagonal = right composed with top, exactly the existing Statement formula and step 1.1.

All unbracketed strings use the same coherence convention explicitly present in the Statement and L3. The top arrow is applied after rebracketing to A tensor (B tensor A) tensor B, and the right arrow after rebracketing to (A tensor A) tensor (B tensor B). Suppression moves brackets only, never tensor factors.

L2 gives eta_A:1 -> A and eta_B:1 -> B; hence eta_A tensor eta_B:1 tensor 1 -> A tensor B. The added prose identifies its source with 1 by the unit isomorphism, matching the original Statement convention. The diagram does not assert associativity/Yang-Baxter or unit compatibility as new edges; existing proof steps 1.1–3.1 remain byte-identical and independent.
